# Draft:Md. Sanwar Jahan Bhuiyan

Md. Sanwar Jahan Bhuiyan is a Bangladeshi civil servant, development administrator, and academician. As of 23 October 2024, he serves as the Secretary at the Bangladesh Public Service Commission (BPSC) Secretariat. He has previously held several key positions in public administration and human resource development in Bangladesh.
Career
Dr. Bhuiyan has had an extensive career in the Bangladesh Civil Service (Administration Cadre) since 1994. Before his current role at BPSC, he served as the Executive Director and CEO of the Bangladesh Computer Council (BCC). He was also the Director (Training and Consultancy) at the National Institute of Local Government (NILG), Dhaka. He served as Deputy Executive Project Director (DEPD) of the ADB-funded Skills for Employment Investment Program (SEIP) under the Finance Division of the Ministry of Finance.
He held various academic and administrative positions at Bangladesh Public Administration Training Centre (BPATC) and Bangladesh Civil Service Administration Academy (BCSAA) for over 13 years. Earlier in his career, he worked at Bangladesh Bank as an Assistant Director before joining the civil service. He also served in field administration as Assistant Commissioner, Magistrate First Class, NDC, and Assistant Commissioner (Land).
Academic Background
Dr. Bhuiyan completed his first Master’s degree in Management with First Class. He earned a second Master’s degree in Human Resource Planning and Development from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi, where he was awarded the IAMR President Medal for academic excellence. He obtained a Post Graduate Diploma (PGD) in Leadership Management from Universiti Utara Malaysia (UUM) with distinction. He earned his Ph.D. in Development Administration from the National Institute of Development Administration (NIDA), Bangkok, with research focused on the transfer of training in management development programs of the Bangladesh Civil Service.
Training and International Exposure
Dr. Bhuiyan received professional training in Leadership Development, Public Policy Analysis, and Development Administration from institutions including:
* University of Wolverhampton, UK
* Duke University, USA
* Macquarie University, Australia
* Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy, National University of Singapore
He is an Australia Awards Fellow under the University of Sunshine Coast, focusing on improving research and policy in the Blue Economy of Bangladesh.
Publications and Academic Contributions
Dr. Bhuiyan has published 9 articles, co-authored training manuals, and edited 12 issues of the journal Loka Proshashon Samoyeeki at BPATC. He has conducted 13 research works, mostly on HRD, governance, and training. He served as an adjunct faculty member at:
* University of Dhaka
* North South University
* East West University
* Bangladesh Institute of Governance and Management (BIGM)
He has also supervised several Master’s dissertations and research projects at BPATC, BIGM, and BRAC University.
Conferences and Symposia
Dr. Bhuiyan served as Conference Chair (jointly) at the International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (IIKM-1), 2019. He was also the Symposium Convener at the First International Symposium on Achieving Agenda 2030 for Sustainable Development (ISAASD), 2019.
Books and Literature
His first literary work titled Greek Puraner Galpo gained significant popularity at the Ekushey Book Fair.
Personal Life
Dr. Bhuiyan is married to Ms. Humaira Jahan Jalsha, and they have a daughter, Aysha Jahan Samia, and a son, Sayeed Jahan Sajid.
